question.text: A portfolio has sub-period returns of -10%, +20%, +10% over 3 years. What is the TWRR (geometric linking, annualized)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Geometric link the wealth relatives: 0.90 x 1.20 x 1.10 = 1.188. Annualized TWRR = 1.188^(1/3) - 1 = 0.0591, i.e. about 5.91%. The Trap: 6.67% is the arithmetic mean; 18.80% is the total cumulative return; 7.13% is a computation error. Note: Geometric linking for TWRR per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.360 and p.364).
